verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches the story glancingly. UCP states that businesses "remain the Merchant of Record," which implies the merchant carries transaction responsibility. AP2 payment mandates and signed authorizations tied to cart state offer verifiable proof of what the agent was authorized to buy, which could matter in disputes. Neither source spells out who bears fraud or chargeback liability for agent-initiated orders. Missing for 10: explicit fraud-liability allocation rules for agent transactions, chargeback and dispute handling documentation, merchant-facing risk and liability policy, and independent corroboration.
